# Desiccant maintenance

The small drying sachets inside each AWS enclosure are consumable parts. They
are there to slow moisture changes around the logger and battery terminals,
not to compensate for a cracked lid or a badly seated cable gland.

## Inspection at visits

Open the enclosure only after brushing loose rain and grit away from the lid.
Check the sachet indicator first, then look for condensation on the inside
surface, damp foam, or droplets around the cable entries. A dry enclosure can
keep its existing sachet; an enclosure with any dampness should receive a
fresh one and a note in the visit record.

## Drying and replacement

Collected sachets may be dried in a low oven at the community workshop and
returned to the spares box once their indicators have changed back. Do not
leave loose granules in an AWS enclosure, and do not reuse a torn sachet.
If condensation returns after replacement, inspect the gasket and glands
rather than adding a second sachet.
